paragraphs: Hi! I'm Jun. I'm a trainee at Star Academy. I get up at six o'clock in the morning. I have a shower and I brush my teeth.
I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I have rice and eggs. Then I go to school at eight o'clock. I have lunch at twelve o'clock. In the afternoon I go to the practice room. I dance and I sing!

story.title: A Day in the Life of Sora
paragraphs: Sora wakes up at half past six in her bedroom. She has a shower in the bathroom and she has rice and soup for breakfast. She goes to school at eight o'clock.

After school she goes to Star Academy. She has a singing lesson at four o'clock and dance practice at five. She always practises hard. She has dinner at half past seven. Then she reads on the sofa in the living room. She goes to bed at half past nine.

story.title: Hana's Home and Family
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Hana. I'm ten years old. I've got a mum, a dad and a little brother, Min. We've got a green house with a red door. There are three bedrooms. My bedroom is pink. There's a bed, a desk and a big window.
Our cat sleeps under my bed. My dog sits next to the sofa in the living room. Every morning I get up at seven o'clock and I have breakfast in the kitchen with my family.

story.title: Debut Day!
paragraphs: Today is a big day. It's the debut show at Star Academy! Jun, Hana, Leo, Sora and Max get up at six o'clock. They have rice and soup for breakfast.

At ten o'clock they have a rehearsal on the stage. Coach Mina says, 'You are ready!' The show starts at half past seven. Their families sit in the front. Sora's grandma has got a yellow flag. The trainees sing and dance. Everybody is happy!
